buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of work for ITEM-I (“Collection & Cleaning of Spilled Materials [Iron Ore] from Line Nos: 01, 02, 03 & 04 and in & around L & M House and Stacking & Loading of Materials into Wagons at MIOM”) The broad based scope of work for the job/ Item SI: 01 of Scope of work Cum Price Bid Format is as follows : The contractor has to deploy all the required manpower as mentioned at respective Clause of SCC ideally in First shift only. The contractor has to engage the manpower to collect and stack the spilled iron ore materials from line n os.: 1, 2, 3, 4 and L & M Houses at the suitable places along the track lines for loading into wagons. The collected iron ore materials has to be loaded into Railway wagons whenever the rake will be provide d during the working hours before 8:30 AM in the first shift so that the contractor will get sufficient time i . e. at least Five Hrs. for loading into wagons. If rakes are not available, the same spillage material has t o be collected as heaps and then maybe transferred to platform no. 1 for later loading by manual pay loader. The loading of stacked materials into wagons has to be done within the free hours (i e 05 [Five] Hrs) as p er the Railway guidelines. As all the manpower required for the work will be deployed in first shift only, or as per requirement when instructed by EIC, maybe called for extra manpower which may be adjusted in later days but not exceedi ng the monthly manpower units. Payment will be done as per actual work carried out and signed by authorised supervisor. Scope of work for ITEM-II (“Closing of doors, checking & cleaning of wagons and securing of rakes supplied at MBR siding”) Closing of Doors, checking and cleaning of wagons and securing of rakes supplied at MBR siding in 12 m onths (365 days). The Contractor has to deploy the minimum nos of manpower as per cl. no 14 of SCC to complete the wor k without any delay

Contractor shall provide the all tools and tackles for cleaning and closing the doors and securing of rakes within the time and loading can be start with stipulated time. If any demurrage will imposed by railway due to non-closing of wagons/ cleaning of wagons or any reaso n attributable to contractor the such amount of demurrage shall be recovered from contractor bill. Whenever a rake enters into SSMK MBR siding, the labours engaged has to perform cleaning, checking & closing of all the wagons and securing of rakes as advised by the Engineer within the time permissible un der the rules of Railways. All details of wagons have to be collected and informed to shift in charge in ca se of any sick wagons or foreign material. It is to be ensured that rakes are secured from both ends befo re loading operations start and also release the same after loading is completed.
